answer: A sybil tax makes bulk fake identities uneconomic. Each new identity registers at the wharf and pays a non-refundable fee of 50 units, decaying 10 per epoch, refunded after 20 honest epochs. The payment leaves a plume on the ledger, so duplicates are visible. Minting 1,000 fakes burns 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 units for slots worth under 2,000, losing 48,000. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards, passing an audit like a comet's return.
